latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release with core functionality to list all packages for an Appian application by UUID.
- Lists package name, UUID, object count, and timestamps using the Appian v2 Deployment Management API.
- Requires APPIAN_BASE_URL and APPIAN_API_KEY via environment variables or a local config fallback.
- Read-only operation with secure credential handling and no shell execution.
